chapters.label: Live: the 2024 World Cup final
chapters.text: The 2024 Futsal World Cup final, in Tashkent. Brazil beat Argentina two one! Goalkeeper Willian, number three, even tries two shots, and wins the Golden Glove.

chapters.label: How he plays out
chapters.text: This is how he plays out. The ball comes back. Willian stops it with his sole, looks up, and passes to the free teammate. Three against two!

chapters.label: Watch again: the pass
chapters.text: Again, slowly. One attacker presses him, so a teammate is free. A flat, firm pass, right to his feet.

chapters.label: Your turn
chapters.text: Your turn! A futsal keeper is a fifth outfield player: be ready to pass with your feet!
